Q: ffmpeg cut first 5 seconds A:

In ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 (only one I checked so far) the position of -ss in the parameter sequence has a meaning (see "man ffmpeg"):

Before input moves the start timer (00:00:00) of video in the uncut file, before output cuts the video file:

ffmpeg -i /home/requiem/Desktop/t1.mp4 -ss 00:00:05 -c copy /home/requiem/Desktop/t2.mp4

Q: How does OSX Activity Monitor match XPC tasks to their initiator process? A:

It seems that activity monitor groups processes for application using responsible process id which could be retriven using this command:

sudo launchctl procinfo <pid> | grep responsible

Q: In SwiftUI Toolbar button and image are visible through full screen overlay view A:

You need to put the NavigationStack inside the ZStack. So it would be (in pseudocode):

body: some View

    ZStack

        Navigation stack
            content()
            .modifiers

        Overlay
